summary: SPEC AMENDMENT (operator-approved 2026-07-31): defer promoting cca_checklist_profile to a required field. Removes acceptance criterion 5 and the scope clause 'add cca_checklist_profile to task.schema.json and validate_shiki's required task fields'. Reason: satisfying them requires backfilling ~98 pre-existing task files, and MergeGate's enforce_untrusted_shiki_mutations blocks a task PR from touching any task file but its own, independently of declared locks, so the criterion is undeliverable through the normal task-PR path. The pre-PR reviewer of the backfill attempt found this; the CCA on PR #226 correctly returned blocked, not complete. The task's substantive capability - refusing a self-contradictory CCA verdict, enforcing checklist-profile coverage when a profile is declared, and a test binding task.schema.json's required set to validate_shiki.TASK_REQUIRED - is delivered and verified unchanged. The task file will no longer match its frozen plan definition on scope and acceptance_checks; that divergence IS this amendment and is recorded here rather than hidden. Mechanism note: this write reaches main through a path MergeGate does not currently guard - a normal task PR may modify its own task file's governance fields. Closing that gap is the next task (ADR 0015 Contract immutability, never implemented outside contract/goal_reconcile/post_merge_reconcile). No supported delivery mode for a Spec Amendment exists today; that is a recorded finding.
